title: Binary Numbers: Counting in 2s
welcome_lead: Counting with only 0 and 1 sounds weird — until you see the pattern.
meta_desc: KS3 binary numbers: counting, place values, bits.
final_note: Master counting in binary and bigger ideas fall into place.

concepts.def: A number system using only 0 and 1.

walkthroughs.body_html: 0=0, 1=1, 2=10, 3=11, 4=100, 5=101, 6=110, 7=111. Each new column doubles the value of the last.
Columns are 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128. Multiply by 2 each time. To read binary, add the values where there's a 1.
Transistors are either on or off. Two states are the simplest, most reliable signal a circuit can hold.
